calendar.news: A flyer went up on the Magnolia Loop bulletin board: Halloween on the Loop, Saturday, October 31. Trick-or-treating from 5 to 7 PM, a golf cart parade around the Loop at 6, then a costume contest at the Town Square bandstand at 7, with prizes for best costume and best-decorated golf cart. Decorations welcome all week.
Reminder on the bulletin board: Halloween on the Loop is tomorrow. Trick-or-treating 5 to 7 PM, the golf cart parade at 6, and the costume contest at the Town Square bandstand at 7.
It's Halloween. Pumpkins are appearing on porches along Magnolia Loop, and the parade sign-up table at Town Square has a clipboard for costume-contest entries.
Trick-or-treaters are out on Magnolia Loop: visiting grandkids in costumes, golf carts trimmed in orange, and doorbells ringing up and down the street.
The Halloween golf cart parade is rolling around Magnolia Loop: carts trimmed in orange lights, cobwebs and jack-o'-lanterns, horns tooting, with neighbors waving from the curb.
The costume contest is starting at the Town Square bandstand. A judge with a clipboard is calling for entries: best costume and best-decorated golf cart.
The morning after Halloween: candy wrappers on the sidewalks, a slumping inflatable ghost, and a note at Town Hall asking that Halloween decorations come down by November 7.
